caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden mold, divided evenly into twelve square sections, each carved with a different design. The designs include various figures, animals, and nature scenes. In the top row, from left to right, there is an image of a branch with leaves and berries, a person holding a branch or sheaf, a bird perched on a branch, and a person standing next to a barrel. The second row shows a nest with eggs on a branch, a bear holding a branch, a person with a shepherd's crook and sheep, and a church with two trees. The third row features a goat, a donkey, a stag lying on the ground, and a deer. The bottom row includes a drummer (person playing a drum), a bird (possibly a turkey or peacock) under a bush, a swan swimming on water, and a sheep. The entire composition is rendered in shades of brown, closely mimicking the appearance of carved wood. The object is set against a plain light background, and the name "Adele Brooks" is written in small letters to the right and below the mold.
title: Pa. German Cookie Cutter
